name: dexteros
description: DexterOS - multi-tenant SaaS cloud desktop for Cloudflare Pages (Functions + D1 + R2)

scripts.dev: npx wrangler pages dev public --d1 DB --r2 MEDIA --compatibility-date=2025-07-18 --persist-to .wrangler/state --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name dexteros
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
